import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set the style for the plot
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a count plot for dog breeds, limited to the top 10 breeds
top_breeds = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index
breed_counts = data[data['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.countplot(data=breed_counts, y='Rasse1Text', order=top_breeds, palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds Registered in Zurich')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
